caption: The PHY adds a 4-byte preamble, 1-byte SFD and 1-byte length before the PSDU; the 127-byte PSDU includes the 2-byte FCS at its end.

spec.title: IEEE 802.15.4 PHY frame

nodes.label: MAC frame (PSDU)
nodes.note: up to 127 B, last 2 B = FCS

spec.aria: An 802.15.4 frame shown left to right: 4-byte preamble, 1-byte SFD, 1-byte length, a MAC frame of up to 127 bytes whose last two bytes are the FCS.
